ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE MOHAMMAD NAWAZ  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioner has sought permission of the Court to withdraw the petition, with a liberty to the petitioner to move the Sessions Court for bail, after the examination of the victim.
2.
In the light of the above submission, petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Liberty is reserved to the petitioner to file a fresh petition before the Sessions Court, after the evidence of the victim is recorded.

Considering that the petitioner is in judicial custody and the charge-sheet is already filed, learned Sessions Judge shall make an endeavor to record the victims evidence, as expeditiously as possible.

Sd/-
